references.text: Micah's offer that the Levite should be 'father and priest' is repeated here when the Danites make the same offer to the Levite.
Joseph describes himself as 'father' to Pharaoh, showing that 'father' can be used as a title for an advisor or spiritual leader.
Elisha calls Elijah 'my father', illustrating the use of 'father' as an honorific title for a spiritual leader.
King Joash calls the prophet Elisha 'my father', confirming the use of this title for spiritual leaders.
Micah had already consecrated his own son as priest before he hired the Levite.
The continuation of this story where the Levite is consecrated as Micah's priest.
